_doc: Datasets parked/removed from active configs after cleanup.
They were removed because of redundancy, schema/loader concerns, clinical overfit risk, or license uncertainty.
Nothing here was deleted from the original file; this is just a record.

sources.name: mental-health-counseling
sources.note: Counseling Q&A data for empathy and sensitive-response behavior. Low weight to avoid making the model sound overly clinical.

sources.name: smoltalk
sources.note: Synthetic SFT dataset used for SmolLM2-Instruct. Broad instruction-following and conversational behavior.

sources.name: tulu3-sft-mixture
sources.note: Large modern SFT mixture. Check licenses carefully; some subsets may be non-commercial.

sources.name: oasst1
sources.note: OpenAssistant Conversations Dataset — fully human-written. KNOWN QUIRK: oasst1 is stored as a flat message tree (each row is a single node with parent_id), so load_dialogue_hf can't reassemble proper multi-turn conversations and falls through to flat-token ingestion ('0 conversations → 2M tokens' in the log). The text is still high-quality human writing so we keep it at low weight as a raw-text quality anchor — not as a structured chat signal. If/when load_dialogue_hf gets an oasst1-tree-reassembly path, restore weight to 2.0.
